title: Codex Global Approval
desc: Configure Codex CLI global defaults for low-friction appbot work: cheap default model, never ask for approval, danger-full-access sandbox for trusted repos, named profiles, and appbot auto-accept environment baseline.
steps: Set model to gpt-5.4-mini for the default worker path unless a stronger model is explicitly needed.
Set ask_for_approval = never and approval_policy = never for compatibility with current and older Codex config keys.
Set sandbox_mode = danger-full-access for trusted local automation sessions.
Add profiles worker, frontier, and readonly so routine execution, strong reasoning, and safe read-only checks are explicit.
Keep trusted project entries for active repos such as WKAppBot, WkAutoQuant, personal-docs, and wkappbot-sdk.
Set WKAPPBOT_AUTO_APPROVE_ALL=1 in User environment when appbot-heavy work should proceed without repeated prompts.
Read codex-auto-approval for default.rules prefix policy before editing approval rules.
Read post-compaction-recovery after context compaction to re-check this baseline.

2026-05-06 appbot skill auto-accept baseline: default.rules should include narrow allow prefixes for wkappbot skill read/search/edit/contribute/install/delete/sync, for both Join-Path (Get-Location) 'bin' and Join-Path D:\GitHub\WKAppBot 'bin' PATH bootstrap forms. Keep WKAPPBOT_AUTO_APPROVE_ALL=1 in User environment.

2026-05-06 global-config auto-accept baseline: default.rules should include narrow allow prefixes for reading and validating C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\config.toml, inspecting C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\rules\default.rules, setting/getting WKAPPBOT_AUTO_APPROVE_ALL, and making timestamped backups before config/rule changes.

2026-05-06 global Codex instructions baseline: keep C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\AGENTS.md as the Codex-side counterpart to C:\Users\kiexp\.claude\CLAUDE.md. It must state default model gpt-5.4-mini, Korean polite final responses, AppBot skill command discipline, auto-accept baseline, process safety, crash reboot console recovery, and handoff/compaction skill reads.
